name: Prefect Integration Binding (Wave 5 Artifact 1)
description: Wave 5 detailed design (artifact 1) defining the Prefect 3.9.2 integration boundary that binds GPWCF's runtime-independent Stage, Step, SPU, and selected Supporting Pattern contracts to Prefect-native Flows, Deployments, Subflows, and Tasks while preserving domain ownership, identities, results, and operational evidence.
